goal: State the implemented product outcome this plan will deliver.
prohibited_scope: Name work that this plan must not perform.

waves.goal: State one bounded, testable implementation outcome.
inputs: Name the approved artifact or repository evidence needed for this wave.
approved_requirements: Name the approved design requirement this wave must satisfy.
render_targets: Name the viewport and state that must be rendered.
tests: Name the smallest check that directly tests this wave's completion criterion.
rollback: State how to reverse this wave safely.
risks: State the main risk and pause condition.
